description: Decode row counts of the DeepSeek-V4 c4 indexer top-512 at a 1M-token context capacity (score width 262208, 4097 pages of 64). Every batch repeats the same 16-row length mix, from an empty row to the full width, and alternates normal and crowded uniform score rows every 16 rows (inputs.py), so small batches are bound by their longest rows and large ones by the total scores read.
